name: classroom-rubrics
description: Repair a Google Classroom rubric or official Sheets export; preserve its template and validate scoring, criteria, performance levels and order. Use when a rubric has duplicate scores, mixed scoring, misordered levels, or a failed Sheets import. Works from pasted text and supplied exports, returning corrected content and a recovery plan. For damaged exports, get edits to apply in Classroom and fresh-export steps; the supplied file stays unchanged.
